data.text: My family taught me to leave enough fish for the next season—and our village depends on us doing that. With 100 tons in the lake, we can catch 50 tons altogether and let the remaining 50 double back to 100. How about 10 tons each this month? That’s $10,000 apiece, and we can keep earning that every month if we stick together. I’ll commit to 10, and we can review everyone’s catches afterward. John, would you agree to that?
